summary: Independent frontend regression of Judge Reset (iteration 8) at 390x844 and 1280x720. Judge Reset button visibility, accessibility (role='button' + exact aria-label), keyboard access (Tab-to-focus + Enter opens modal), Cancel-is-inert, Confirm clears exactly the intended stores (with unrelated-key survival + audio-settings rewritten to defaults), immediate Toronto replay, ENABLE SOUND network audio (HTTP 206 on /audio/*.mp3), zero pageerrors, Awaken/all 7 portals, Work portal navigation and canonical /hub — ALL PASS. Only regression found: /hub has horizontal overflow at 390x844 (scrollWidth 492 vs clientWidth 390 = 102px overflow) caused by the 590px-wide absolute orbitLine on a non-clipped root. All other viewports/paths clean.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at /hub on 390x844: document.scrollWidth=492 vs clientWidth=390 (102px overflow). Root cause: styles.orbitLine is 590px wide, absolutely positioned at the root View (which has no overflow:hidden). Users can scroll horizontally on mobile at the hub. Not present at desktop 1280 nor at root '/'. Reference: /app/frontend/components/staarwardd/cinematic-hub.tsx:190-191 (root style needs overflow:'hidden').

issues: Horizontal scroll present because orbitLine (590x590) escapes viewport; add overflow:'hidden' to styles.root.

action_items: Add overflow: 'hidden' to CinematicHub styles.root (cinematic-hub.tsx line ~190) to eliminate the 102px horizontal overflow at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: Judge Reset code (components/staarwardd/judge-reset.tsx) is clean, best-effort, awaits AsyncStorage.multiRemove, then rewrites audio defaults, then router.replace('/'). Confirmed behaviour matches spec exactly.

GuardianActivityProvider (lib/staarwardd/guardian-activity.tsx:28-45) proactively removes 'staarwardd.v13.guardian-receipts' on mount when shouldClearGuardianReceipts(memory) is true (e.g. when memory is not-consented / expired). This is why the seeded '[]' value is null right after the hub loads — but Cancel itself is fully inert. Behaviour is correct by design; noting for context.

success_rate.frontend: 97% (7/8 checks fully pass; 1 layout regression at /hub@390)

seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded per spec (5 staarwardd.* keys + unrelated-key='keep') prior to Cancel and Confirm cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Judge Reset (⟲) is fully compliant. The only remaining fix is CinematicHub styles.root overflow:'hidden' to clip the 590px orbitLine on ≤500px viewports. Once main agent applies that one-line fix, re-run only step 8 layout check at /hub@390x844 to verify scrollWidth <= clientWidth.
rca_of_issue: Horizontal overflow at /hub@390: styles.orbitLine width/height = 590, position: 'absolute', alignSelf: 'center' — with a root View that has {flex:1, backgroundColor:'#080B14'} but no overflow clipping. On viewports narrower than 590, the ring extends 100px past the right edge and enlarges document.scrollWidth. Fix: add overflow: 'hidden' to styles.root (or wrap orbitLine and command area in an overflow-hidden container). Screenshot captured during test shows the ring extending past the right edge on mobile.
